decision_contract.research_question: Does shortening the Stage-1 imminent-flip prediction horizon from 300s to 180s improve flip prediction precision/discrimination and the economic quality of high-confidence predictions, while preserving a significant amount of favorable excursion opportunity?

baseline.short: parent's exact canonical feature instances (A/B/C), target horizon shortened only
baseline.long: parent's exact canonical feature instances (A/B/C), target horizon shortened only

model_arms.A: explicit canonical baseline (arrival_velocity, arrival_acceleration, ema_slope) -- identical to parent
model_arms.B: A plus completed-bar prior 1m/5m structural regime geometry -- identical to parent
model_arms.C: B plus completed-1s rolling 300s productivity -- identical to parent

decision_contract.primary_comparison: Frozen 300s Model C (parent baseline) vs. frozen untuned 180s architecture winner vs. frozen tuned 180s winner, on 2024 OOS, opened only after explicit post-freeze authorization.
decision_contract.terminal_question: Does tightening the flip-prediction horizon to 180s remove bad predictions faster than it removes valuable reversal opportunity?
